_comment: Tables a migration is allowed to leave populated, and why. Both isolated-database fixtures
(tests/integration/local-domain.ts and scripts/run-local-workflow.mjs) refuse to run unless
every other table is empty, so a migration that smuggles in state is caught rather than
silently exercised. The two copies of that rule drifted once and cost two red CI runs, so the
list lives here and both read it. A test asserts both fixtures agree with this file.

tables.geo_places: The gazetteer (migration 16): read-only geography, identical on every instance.
tables.directory_places: The published public directory (migration 17): reference data, not a record.
tables.data_retention_settings: Retention windows (migration 21): configuration with CHECK (id = 1), seeded so the enforced numbers are a row rather than prose. No personal or operational record.
